instruction.hanzi: 读一读，说说这些词语是什么意思。
instruction.english: Read the words and phrases aloud and say what they mean.

items.english: have been there twice
have never seen
very interesting
to go out and have fun
a sunny day
a hundred days
although ..., (still) ...

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 安娜，你去过学校旁边那个新饭馆吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Ānnà, nǐ qùguo xuéxiào pángbiān nàge xīn fànguǎn ma?
dialogue.english: Anna, have you been to that new restaurant next to the school?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 去过两次。那儿的鱼非常好吃。
dialogue.pinyin: Qùguo liǎng cì. Nàr de yú fēicháng hǎochī.
dialogue.english: I've been twice. Their fish is really good.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我还没去过呢。这个星期六我们一起去吧？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi qùguo ne. Zhège xīngqīliù wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba?
dialogue.english: I haven't been yet. Shall we go together this Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 好啊！吃完饭我们去哪儿玩儿？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a! Chīwán fàn wǒmen qù nǎr wánr?
dialogue.english: Sure! Where shall we go for fun after we eat?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我们去看电影，怎么样？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng, zěnmeyàng?
dialogue.english: How about a movie?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 好，我还没在中国看过电影呢。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ hái méi zài Zhōngguó kànguo diànyǐng ne.
dialogue.english: Great. I've never seen a movie in China.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 王明，你看过这个电影吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Wáng Míng, nǐ kànguo zhège diànyǐng ma?
dialogue.english: Wang Ming, have you seen this movie?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 看过一次。虽然有三个小时，但是非常有意思。
dialogue.pinyin: Kànguo yí cì. Suīrán yǒu sān ge xiǎoshí, dànshì fēicháng yǒu yìsi.
dialogue.english: Once. It's three hours long, but really interesting.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我也想看，但是我可能听不懂。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng kàn, dànshì wǒ kěnéng tīng bu dǒng.
dialogue.english: I'd like to see it too, but I might not understand it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 你不是学了一年汉语了吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì xuéle yì nián Hànyǔ le ma?
dialogue.english: Haven't you been studying Chinese for a year?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 虽然我学了一年，但是电影里的人说话太快了。
dialogue.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ xuéle yì nián, dànshì diànyǐng li de rén shuōhuà tài kuài le.
dialogue.english: I have, but people in movies talk way too fast.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 没关系，我们一起看，有问题你就问我。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒmen yìqǐ kàn, yǒu wèntí nǐ jiù wèn wǒ.
dialogue.english: No problem. We'll watch it together, and you can ask me if anything's unclear.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 马克，明天天气怎么样？
dialogue.pinyin: Mǎkè, míngtiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
dialogue.english: Mark, what's the weather like tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 手机上说明天是晴天，不冷也不热。
dialogue.pinyin: Shǒujī shang shuō míngtiān shì qíngtiān, bù lěng yě bú rè.
dialogue.english: My phone says it'll be sunny tomorrow, not cold and not hot.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 太好了！我们去外面玩儿吧。你踢过足球吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒmen qù wàimiàn wánr ba. Nǐ tīguo zúqiú ma?
dialogue.english: Great! Let's do something outdoors. Have you ever played soccer?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 踢过很多次！但是来中国以后我一次也没踢过。
dialogue.pinyin: Tīguo hěn duō cì! Dànshì lái Zhōngguó yǐhòu wǒ yí cì yě méi tīguo.
dialogue.english: Lots of times! But I haven't played once since I came to China.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 那明天我们叫王明一起去踢足球。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà míngtiān wǒmen jiào Wáng Míng yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú.
dialogue.english: Then tomorrow let's get Wang Ming and go play soccer.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 好！晴天踢足球最好了。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo! Qíngtiān tī zúqiú zuì hǎo le.
dialogue.english: Sounds good! A sunny day is perfect for soccer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我来北京已经一百天了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ lái Běijīng yǐjīng yìbǎi tiān le.
dialogue.english: I've been in Beijing for a hundred days now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 这一百天里，我坐过很多次公共汽车，也坐过两次飞机。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè yìbǎi tiān li, wǒ zuòguo hěn duō cì gōnggòng qìchē, yě zuòguo liǎng cì fēijī.
dialogue.english: In these hundred days I've taken the bus lots of times, and I've flown twice.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我去过三次王明家，他妈妈做的菜非常好吃。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ qùguo sān cì Wáng Míng jiā, tā māma zuò de cài fēicháng hǎochī.
dialogue.english: I've been to Wang Ming's home three times. His mom's cooking is delicious.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 北京的天气不错，晴天很多。
dialogue.pinyin: Běijīng de tiānqì búcuò, qíngtiān hěn duō.
dialogue.english: The weather in Beijing is nice. There are lots of sunny days.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 虽然我的汉语还不太好，但是我每天都很快乐。
dialogue.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ de Hànyǔ hái bú tài hǎo, dànshì wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn kuàilè.
dialogue.english: My Chinese still isn't very good, but I'm happy every day.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我觉得在北京学习汉语非常有意思！
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zài Běijīng xuéxí Hànyǔ fēicháng yǒu yìsi!
dialogue.english: I think studying Chinese in Beijing is great fun!

explanation.hanzi: "动词＋过"表示过去有过这样的经历，常常翻译成"曾经……"。否定形式是"没（有）＋动词＋过"，不用"不"。问别人的经历可以说"……过……吗？"或者"……过……没有？"。
explanation.english: Verb + 过 (guo, neutral tone) says that something has happened at least once in the past, so it's part of your experience: 我去过那个饭馆 "I've been to that restaurant (before)". It doesn't say when; it's about having had the experience. The negative uses 没(有), never 不: 我没吃过羊肉 "I've never eaten lamb". To ask, add 吗 or 没有 at the end: 你看过这个电影吗? / 你看过这个电影没有? Compare 了, which reports that a specific action got done.

examples.hanzi: 我去过学校旁边的那个饭馆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùguo xuéxiào pángbiān de nàge fànguǎn.
examples.english: I've been to that restaurant next to the school.
Xiaomei has never been on a plane.
Have you ever seen a Chinese movie?
Mark had never studied Chinese before.

explanation.hanzi: "虽然A，但是B"表示先承认A是真的，可是B还是这样，B是说话人想强调的意思。"虽然"可以放在主语前面，也可以放在主语后面。英语只用一个词（although 或者 but），汉语两个词常常一起用。
explanation.english: 虽然 A，但是 B means "although A, B (anyway)": you admit A is true, then say B still holds. B is the point you really want to make. Unlike English, which uses either "although" or "but", Chinese normally uses both words together. 虽然 can come before or after the subject of the first clause: 虽然我学了一年 / 我虽然学了一年. 但是 always starts the second clause.

examples.hanzi: 虽然外面很冷，但是教室里很热。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn hěn lěng, dànshì jiàoshì li hěn rè.
examples.english: Although it's cold outside, it's warm in the classroom.

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服虽然有点儿贵，但是很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu suīrán yǒudiǎnr guì, dànshì hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: This piece of clothing is a bit expensive, but it's really pretty.

examples.hanzi: 虽然王明是中国人，但是他不喜欢喝茶。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Wáng Míng shì Zhōngguórén, dànshì tā bù xǐhuan hē chá.
examples.english: Although Wang Ming is Chinese, he doesn't like tea.

examples.hanzi: 虽然下雨了，但是我们还是去踢足球了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán xià yǔ le, dànshì wǒmen háishi qù tī zúqiú le.
examples.english: It rained, but we still went to play soccer.

explanation.hanzi: "数词＋次"放在动词（或者"动词＋过/了"）后面，说明动作做了几次。宾语是一般的东西时，"几次"放在宾语前面：看过两次电影。宾语是人称代词时，"几次"放在宾语后面：见过他一次。宾语是地方时，两种都可以：去过两次北京／去过北京两次。
explanation.english: To say how many times something happens, put number + 次 after the verb (and after 过 or 了 if there is one): 去过两次 "have been twice". Where does the object go? With an ordinary object, the count comes first: 看过两次电影 "have seen two movies / gone to the movies twice". With a pronoun, the count comes after it: 见过他一次 "have met him once". With a place name, both orders are fine: 去过两次北京 or 去过北京两次. To ask, use 几次: 你去过几次? "How many times have you been?"

examples.english: I've been to the airport twice.

examples.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng wǒ kànguo sān cì.
examples.english: I've seen this movie three times.

examples.hanzi: 马克每个星期打两次篮球。
examples.pinyin: Mǎkè měi ge xīngqī dǎ liǎng cì lánqiú.
examples.english: Mark plays basketball twice a week.

prompt.hanzi: 两人一组，分角色读课文。
prompt.english: In pairs, read the dialogues aloud, taking one role each.

prompt.hanzi: 用"过、次、虽然、有意思、晴"填空。
prompt.english: Fill in the blanks with 过, 次, 虽然, 有意思 or 晴.

items.hanzi: 我去____那个饭馆，菜很好吃。
items.english: I've been to that restaurant. The food is good.
I've seen this movie twice.
Although it's cold outside, it's warm in the classroom.
This book is really interesting. You should read it too.

items.hanzi: 今天是____天，我们去外面玩儿吧。
items.english: It's a sunny day today. Let's go out and have fun.

prompt.hanzi: 根据你的情况回答问题。

items.hanzi: 你去过中国吗？去过几次？
items.pinyin: Nǐ qùguo Zhōngguó ma? Qùguo jǐ cì?
items.english: Have you been to China? How many times?
Have you ever been on a plane?

items.hanzi: 你看过中国电影吗？有意思吗？
items.pinyin: Nǐ kànguo Zhōngguó diànyǐng ma? Yǒu yìsi ma?
items.english: Have you seen any Chinese movies? Were they interesting?

items.hanzi: 晴天的时候，你喜欢去哪儿玩儿？
items.pinyin: Qíngtiān de shíhou, nǐ xǐhuan qù nǎr wánr?
items.english: On sunny days, where do you like to go for fun?

prompt.english: Match each question with a suitable answer.

items.hanzi: 你吃过羊肉吗？ — 吃过，吃过很多次。
items.pinyin: Nǐ chīguo yángròu ma? — Chīguo, chīguo hěn duō cì.
items.english: Have you ever eaten lamb? — Yes, many times.

items.hanzi: 这个电影怎么样？ — 虽然我不太懂，但是很有意思。
items.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng zěnmeyàng? — Suīrán wǒ bú tài dǒng, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi.
items.english: How's this movie? — I didn't really understand it, but it's very interesting.

items.hanzi: 你来过这儿吗？ — 没来过，这是第一次。
items.pinyin: Nǐ láiguo zhèr ma? — Méi láiguo, zhè shì dì-yī cì.
items.english: Have you been here before? — No, this is my first time.

items.hanzi: 明天天气怎么样？ — 是晴天，不冷。
items.pinyin: Míngtiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng? — Shì qíngtiān, bù lěng.
items.english: What's the weather like tomorrow? — Sunny, and not cold.

radicals.english: rain (a squashed form of 雨 on top; related to weather)
cowrie shell (shells were once used as money; related to money and value)

prompt.hanzi: 小组活动：说说你的经历。
prompt.english: Group work: talk about your experiences.

activities: "Have you ever...?" survey: each person writes five questions with 过 (你吃过……吗？/ 你去过……吗？). Walk around and ask; when someone says yes, follow up with 去过几次？/ 吃过几次？ Report the most interesting answer to the group.
Recommend a movie, book or restaurant to your partner using 虽然……，但是……: 这个电影虽然……，但是很有意思。
Write and read aloud a short "My first hundred days" paragraph like Mark's: where you've been, what you've done and how many times.
